summary: For every four-connected nonzero solid monochromatic rectangle, preserve the zero background and the complete rectangle border. Within each rectangle, compute zero-based interior coordinates from that rectangle’s own top-left interior cell; replace even (interior_row + interior_col) parity cells with 0 and retain the rectangle color on odd parity cells. Apply this independently to every rectangle.
